en.summary: Revenue was broadly flat, while higher gross profit did not offset rising operating expenses. Cash generation improved sequentially.
findings: Revenue was $28.046B versus $28.095B a year ago. GAAP gross margin was 19.6%, compared with 18.0%.
Operating expenses rose to $4.776B from $3.430B. Operating income fell to $718M, despite improved gross profit.
Operating cash flow was $6.263B and capital expenditure was $4.732B, producing $1.531B free cash flow versus $3.990B a year ago.

follow_ups.question: Will growth sustain earnings and cash returns after investment?
follow_ups.update: Monitor demand, expenses, working capital and cash capital purchases.
follow_ups.next_check: Next quarterly disclosure and official supplemental materials.

limitations: A research snapshot of the listed official materials. Official earnings-call text was not collected.
Standalone and cumulative periods are treated separately; cash flows may require adjacent cumulative-period subtraction. Missing values are not zero.
No pre-release consensus snapshot was retained. Unverified numerical guidance is omitted from the guidance table.

metrics.label: GAAP gross margin
metrics.definition: GAAP gross profit divided by quarterly revenue.

metrics.label: Calculated free cash flow
metrics.definition: Standalone quarterly operating cash flow less cash capital purchases.
